name: Bites
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm of Tiny beasts's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm of Tiny beasts has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
